'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Terwilliger LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Terwilliger]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Sheet '''Chris Twiggs'''; dest [[Chris Terwilliger]]. Start [[Center Of Tyranny (V)]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Center Of Tyranny (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
